findings.issue: The PR description's opening 'This PR ...' paragraph (the release note) names declarations and files that do not exist here: `TauCeti.pairedCoordinateRotation`, `TauCeti.exists_linearIsometryEquiv_inner_self_eq_zero`, `TauCeti.greatCircleHomotopy`, `TauCeti/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Euclidean/Complex.lean` and `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/HairyBall.lean`. It also claims the PR proves the hairy ball theorems and `degree_neg_sphere`, which are already on main and unchanged in this diff. It also misnames the new theorems: `exists_continuous_section_ne_zero_iff`, `exists_contMDiff_section_ne_zero_iff` and `exists_continuous_inner_sphere_eq_zero_ne_zero_iff` do not exist; the actual names end in `_iff_odd` / `_and_ne_zero_iff_odd`.

summary: The module and declaration docstrings in both changed files are accurate and complete, but the PR description (the release note) describes declarations, files and theorem names that this PR does not contain.
